name: world-time-reminder
description: A Windows taskbar Beijing clock with exact-hour first-duty reminders.

interface.shortDescription: 显示北京时间并在固定整点提醒休息
interface.longDescription: Build and install a single-instance Windows taskbar clock that displays Beijing time and shows an exact-hour first-duty rest reminder. The current-user task restarts the clock after logon or loss of the process without running an independent reminder program.
defaultPrompt: 检查世界时间提醒是否正在运行
